_comment: components maps each inlined component id to a short hash of the snippet it was built from. A differing hash means the library has moved on since this site was delivered - which is the question the care plan has to answer.
_allow_past_dates_reason: The case study's publication date. A case study about finished work is supposed to be in the past.

allow_strings.hello@example.co.uk: Deliberate. RFC 2606 reserves example.co.uk for exactly this, so the address cannot reach a real person. A plausible invented domain could belong to somebody. Replace with the real address on a client site, and with the demo's own domain the day this is deployed.
allow_strings.example.co.uk: Same as above - the domain half of the reserved fictional address.
allow_strings.ph-photo: Honest. This site has no photographs because the library ships none and will not use stock. The hero is a CSS stand-in at the true aspect ratio, so real pictures drop in without moving the layout. On a client site this must become a real with width, height and loading.
